description: Query known vulnerabilities for a single package version using {name, ecosystem, version} or {purl, version?}; supply exactly one embedded or separate version. Returns all matching OSV advisories with severity (CVSS vectors), CVE aliases, affected version ranges, and the fixed versions listed for the queried package. Use osv_list_ecosystems to validate the ecosystem string before querying — ecosystem strings are case-sensitive exact matches and an invalid value returns an error, not empty results. For overflow, repeat the original input with page: overflow.page. Continue the same path with offset: page.nextOffset and revision: page.revision until nextOffset is null. Retrieve each entries[].deferred.path separately at offset zero without a revision. Do not pass the output page object as input. Set page.advisoryId to an announced ID to fetch its fields with fixes and severity for the queried package; retain advisoryId on subsequent pages. Pages are fresh lookups; restart a changed node without a revision. Transmission overflow and upstream truncated are separate; neither confirms clean.

name.description: Exact package name in its ecosystem.

page.description: Repeat the original input with page: overflow.page first; later select path, offset: page.nextOffset and revision: page.revision. Retain advisoryId when set.

advisoryId.description: ID from this query’s advisory list. Retain this ID when continuing its fields with fixes and severity for the original package.

offset.description: Start at zero; on later calls set this to the previous page.nextOffset until it is null. Text offsets count Unicode code points.

path.description: Field pointer announced by overflow or entries[].deferred.path; empty string selects the root. Keep the same path while following nextOffset.

revision.description: Use page.revision only when continuing the same path. Omit on the first call to any deferred child path; restart without it after stale_page_revision.

purl.description: PURL alternative to name and ecosystem; supply one embedded or separate version.

version.description: Exact package version, never a range.

name: osv_query_package

effectiveQuery.description: The package@version (ecosystem) tuple as queried, echoed for content-only clients.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_purl`: The PURL is malformed. `unsupported_purl`: OSV does not support this PURL type or namespace. `invalid_purl_version`: Both or neither version sources were supplied. `invalid_purl_query`: OSV rejected the PURL query. `invalid_page_path`: The pointer is unknown or cannot fit a bounded page. `stale_page_revision`: The re-fetched node changed after its revision was announced. `advisory_not_found`: The selected advisory no longer exists. `invalid_ecosystem`: The ecosystem string is not recognized by OSV. Ecosystem names are case-sensitive exact matches. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

notice.description: Present on the clean path — confirms no known vulnerabilities for the queried package.

overflow.description: Transmission overflow disclosure; independent of upstream truncation.

complete.description: Complete top-level fields retained in this response.

notice.description: Transmission omission and fresh re-fetch semantics.

omitted.description: Omitted values, all addressable through page.path.

items.description: An oversized child; parent offset advances past this descriptor.

path.description: Exact child pointer to retrieve separately.

total.description: Number of child entries or Unicode code points; one for scalars.

page.description: Repeat the original tool input with page: overflow.page. Later select path, offset: page.nextOffset and revision: page.revision; do not pass the output page object.

offset.description: Start at zero; on later calls set this to the previous page.nextOffset until it is null. Text offsets count Unicode code points.

path.description: Field pointer announced by overflow or entries[].deferred.path; empty string selects the root. Keep the same path while following nextOffset.

revision.description: Use page.revision only when continuing the same path. Omit on the first call to any deferred child path; restart without it after stale_page_revision.

page.description: One bounded page of an addressed normalized node.

entries.description: Source-order entries for arrays, objects and scalars.

items.description: One source entry, complete or deferred.

deferred.description: Retrievable child descriptor when its value does not fit.

path.description: Exact child pointer to retrieve separately.

total.description: Number of child entries or Unicode code points; one for scalars.

key.description: Object key or original array index.

nextOffset.description: Next offset, strictly greater or null when finished.

notice.description: Fresh re-fetch disclosure; no saved historical snapshot.

revision.description: SHA-256 revision of the addressed normalized node; batch collection uses original input order.

text.description: Verbatim Unicode code-point slice for strings.

total.description: Total entries or Unicode code points.

preview.description: Compact view; overflow identifies omissions. This is not the complete record.

purl.description: Original PURL when used instead of the package tuple.

truncated.description: True when OSV returned more result pages than the fetch cap could follow — the vulnerability list may be INCOMPLETE. A truncated empty list is NOT a clean result; raise OSV_QUERY_MAX_PAGES or narrow the query.

vulns.description: Vulnerabilities matching this package version. An empty array means no known vulnerabilities ONLY when truncated is false.

affectedRanges.description: Version ranges affected by this vulnerability.

ecosystem.description: Affected package ecosystem. Empty for source-only advisory ranges.

events.description: Ordered event boundaries for this range — the loss-free view preserving multiple introduced/fixed pairs the scalar fields collapse.

value.description: Version string or commit identifier at this boundary.

fixed.description: The last "fixed" event of this range (convenience view — a multi-interval range carries several; see events[]).

introduced.description: First affected version (convenience view — see events[]).

lastAffected.description: Last affected version. Present when no fix exists (convenience view — see events[]).

packageName.description: Affected package name (may differ from queried name for umbrella advisories). Empty for source-only advisory ranges.

repo.description: Source repository URL for GIT ranges. Absent on version ranges.

versions.description: Explicit affected versions listed on this package entry. Absent or empty when affected versions are expressed only as ranges.

aliases.description: Alternative IDs — typically CVE IDs (e.g. ["CVE-2020-28500"]). Accepted by nist-nvd-mcp-server for CVSS scores and CISA KEV status.

items.description: A CVE ID or other alias.

cweIds.description: CWE weakness IDs (e.g. ["CWE-79", "CWE-94"]). Populated on GHSA-sourced records; empty otherwise.

fixedVersions.description: Every fixed version the advisory lists for the queried package, in record order. A multi-interval range contributes one per interval (typically one per release line); affectedRanges shows which interval each one closes. Excludes other packages' fixes and GIT commits. Empty when the advisory lists no fix for this package.

items.description: A version that fixes the vulnerability for the queried package.

id.description: OSV vulnerability ID (e.g. "GHSA-29mw-wpgm-hmr9", "PYSEC-2024-1"). Pass to osv_get_vulnerability to retrieve the full advisory record.

published.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the advisory was published.

severity.description: Record-level severity entries (CVSS vectors, Ubuntu priorities). Empty for advisories not yet scored and for advisories that score each affected package separately — severitySource then carries the queried package entry used.

score.description: CVSS vector string (e.g. "CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:N/I:N/A:L"), or the Ubuntu priority (e.g. "medium") for type "Ubuntu".

severityLabel.description: Severity label ("LOW", "MODERATE", "HIGH", "CRITICAL") from the first source that yields one: database_specific.severity, an Ubuntu priority, then the highest CVSS v3/v4 score (0.1–3.9 LOW, 4.0–6.9 MODERATE, 7.0–8.9 HIGH, 9.0–10.0 CRITICAL). Uses the queried package's affected-level severity entries when the record-level list is empty. Null when no source yields a label.

computedScore.description: CVSS score computed from the vector as published: a CVSS 4.0 vector over every metric group it carries (threat and environmental included), a CVSS 3.x vector with its temporal metrics. Present only for CVSS sources.

score.description: The published value the label came from: the database_specific.severity text, the Ubuntu priority, or the CVSS vector.

type.description: Source kind: the database_specific.severity label, an Ubuntu priority, or a CVSS vector.

severitySource.description: The severity entry severityLabel was derived from. Null exactly when the label is.
